face_normals — 3D mesh_process op

• Data kinds: mesh → normals

• Call: import mesh_props; mesh_props.face_normals(mesh) -> 'np.ndarray' (or ops3d.get("face_normals"))

Usage

The face normals of a triangle mesh (the unit normal of each triangle). → (M,3).
